description: Discover the available Zotero tools by keyword — useful for progressive disclosure when you do not want to load every tool definition up front (the code-execution-with-MCP pattern). Pass an optional `query` (matched against tool names, titles, and descriptions) and `detail` ("names" or "descriptions", default "descriptions"). Returns the matching `zotero_*` tools so you can pick the right one for a task. With no query, returns the full catalog.

query.description: Keyword to match against tool names/titles/descriptions.

name: search_tools

tools.description: The matching tools, or the whole catalog when no query was given.

description.description: First 220 characters of the tool description; omitted with detail:"names".

title: Discover Zotero tools
